stem: Before the next dispensing, a prescriber telephones an emergency Nucynta order when immediate therapy is necessary and no written prescription can be delivered first. What quantity may be dispensed?

choices.text: Dispense the full quantity written in the later follow-up prescription after documenting whether the initial emergency oral quantity were not limited to the emergency period.
Limit the emergency supply to exactly 72 hours.
Dispense no more than the amount necessary for the emergency period and follow the emergency Schedule II documentation pathway.
Decline every oral Schedule II order, even in a defined emergency.
Use a seven-day supply cap as the federal emergency quantity standard.

What quantity may be dispensed?'.

related_facts: tapentadol (Nucynta) is used for acute pain severe enough to require an opioid and certain neuropathic pain formulations; it is federal Schedule II and Massachusetts Schedule II.

In a defined emergency, a pharmacist may dispense an oral Schedule II prescription only in the quantity necessary for the emergency period after immediate communication with and reasonable identification of the prescriber.
